scope: Fresh isolated browser contexts. Each cycle creates, edits, reattaches twice, replaces, reopens and disposes an editor; owned storage is deleted. Tracks newly constructed Workers/BroadcastChannels/ResizeObservers and workbook data/commit subscriptions. Counts measure explicit terminate/close/disconnect/unsubscribe calls, not physical process retention. Chromium main-target heap/DOM samples follow requested GC every 10 cycles; Worker/process heap is unavailable. No hard heap threshold or universal leak-free certification.
